title: Defensive programming: server protocol validation hardening
description:
Server trusts client data it should validate at the protocol boundary.

1. Zone names not validated against game definition — invalid zones pass through to engine
2. Component types not validated against definition — non-existent types accepted
3. Default zone names ("board", "deck") assumed without existence check
4. Coordinates validated for format but not against grid dimensions

Fix: Validate zone names and component types in protocol.rs validate_action() against the room definition. Validate default zone names exist. Bounds-check coordinates against known grid dimensions at the protocol boundary, not just in the engine.
close_reason: Zone names, component types, promote_to, draw_from, shuffle_zone all validated against game definition at protocol boundary.
